blocks.head: alt UserX is not near any device
alt UserX is near the device
alt UserX is near the device
alt UserX is near the device
alt A ticket of the device was issued more than 2 time units ago

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceA 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : deviceA , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceA 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < deviceA | (...) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceA 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < deviceA | (...) > $ deviceA 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (randomStr('Secret', N) ; CurrentTime) .

eq < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : Tickets , ..) , ...) > $ deviceA 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (Secret ; IssuedAt) 
= < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , 'issuedAt' : IssuedAt , ..) , ...) > .

ceq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , 'issuedAt' : IssuedAt , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'getKey' cloudA 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , 'issuedAt' : IssuedAt , ...) , ....) > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret) if IssuedAt == CurrentTime .

eq < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : nils , ..) > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret) 
= < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret) , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (KnownSecrets) , ..) > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret) 
= < UserX | ('knownSecrets' : (Secret , KnownSecrets) , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceA : ('owner' : nils , 'tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (Secret) 
= < cloudA | (deviceA : ('owner' : UserX , 'tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceA : ('owner' : Owner , 'owners' : Owners , 'tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'joinDevice' cloudA | (Secret) 
= < cloudA | (deviceA : ('owner' : Owner , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , 'tickets' : (Secret , Tickets) , ..) , ...) > .

ceq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : Tickets , 'issuedAt' : IssuedAt , ...) , ....) > 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceA : ('tickets' : nils , 'issuedAt' : nils , ...) , ....) > if CurrentTime - IssuedAt > 2 .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .
